ui.name: dropdown-menu
ui.summary: Renders a button that toggles a panel of links.
ui.guidance: This is a disclosure, not an ARIA menu: it deliberately does not claim role="menu", because that role promises arrow-key navigation between menuitems, and claiming a keyboard contract the widget does not implement is worse for a screen-reader user than presenting an honest expandable button. The panel is a native popover and the trigger opens it declaratively with popovertarget, so the commands disclose, and every link among them works, with no script at all; the platform also supplies light dismiss, Escape and the top layer, so the panel is never clipped by a scrolling table cell. The Alpine component adds focus into the panel on open, focus back to the trigger on close, arrow keys, typeahead, and keeping aria-expanded in step.
ui.keyboard: Focus moves into the panel on open and back to the trigger on close, Escape closes it, ArrowUp/ArrowDown and Home/End move between commands, and a printable character jumps to the next command starting with it.
